preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer T representing the number of test cases.
The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 10 and 1 <= M <= N * (N - 1) // 2 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 2 and 10, and M is within the valid range for a simple graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10 for u, v, w in all_edges)
preconditions.description: All edges connect distinct valid intersections with weights between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set((min(u, v), max(u, v)) for u, v, w in edges)) == len(edges) for edges in all_edge_lists)
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate edges between any pair of intersections.

preconditions.expression: all(is_connected(1, N, edges) for edges in all_edge_lists)
preconditions.description: There is at least one path from intersection 1 to intersection N in every test case.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == count_shortest_paths(test_cases[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains the count of shortest paths from node 1 to node N for the corresponding test case.
